delivery.en: Letters can come to the house; other parcels are collected at Barbados Postal Service with ID
delivery.zh: 文件可送到住址，非文件包裹要到巴貝多郵政憑證件領取

readback.en: After 246, numbers go 3-3-4; 0 as zero; Barbados dollars; 12-hour time; day before month
readback.zh: 246 區碼後照 3-3-4 唸，0 唸 zero；巴貝多元；12 時制；先日後月

fraud.en: A lottery you never entered, or a plea to clear a container at the port, is a scam
fraud.zh: 說你中了沒參加過的彩票或遺產，或港口有貨櫃要付報關費，都是詐騙

habits.en: More formal than US chat: Good afternoon with strangers. Say mobile, not cell. Use Barbados dollars.
habits.zh: 比美國閒聊客氣，對生人說 Good afternoon。說 mobile 不說 cell。用巴貝多元。

stall_local.en: The parcel is still at the post office, and a helper would need written authorisation plus ID.
stall_local.zh: 包裹還要到郵局親自領，代領的人得帶書面授權與證件。

reason.zh: 美國包裹櫃文化；巴貝多非文件件是到郵政窗口憑證件領
不是巴貝多日常轉帳的叫法
美式用語；當地英語較常說 mobile
美國稅務機關，不宜當作本地詐騙的預設話術

talk_style_diff.en: Keep the five steps, but start more formally with strangers and stay in Bajan-style British English. Mention Barbados dollars, not US tax or Medicare hooks.
talk_style_diff.zh: 五級可沿用，但對生人一開口就更正式，用巴貝多那種英式英語。金額說巴貝多元，不要用美國稅務或 Medicare 當話鉤。

uncertain: 中文 fraud 把遺產一併寫入，來源裡彩票與港口貨櫃較明確，遺產是同一則警察訪談中的例子。
日期口頭是否一律先日後月，未見官方規定。
